questions.prompt: Which host directories or agent configurations should the Docker container target for scanning and importing?
questions.description: We need to mount these into the container to read them.

questions.prompt: Which ax- libraries (advanced agentic patterns) should we prioritize evaluating for inclusion?
questions.description: You mentioned this should be up for debate. Let's select the candidates to research.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Evaluate all for applicability, but prioritize ax-llm as the foundation.

questions.prompt: What should the 'hybrid contextual backend' consist of?
questions.description: This stores the imported context and makes it available to agents.
questions.recommendedAnswer: A vector database (for semantic search) combined with a graph database (for entity relationships).

options.label: Vector DB + Graph DB (e.g. pgvector + Neo4j/Graphify)
Vector DB + Relational DB (e.g. Chroma + SQLite)

questions.prompt: What is the preferred 'one-line install' experience?
questions.description: How will the user run this system?
questions.recommendedAnswer: A docker run command that automatically mounts the necessary host directories.

options.label: Direct `docker run` command with volume mounts
`curl | bash` script that sets up the container and mounts
`docker compose up` from a downloaded url
